method: positional alignment of Kühn page anchors; the Arabic index is sequential over the same span, so anchor i corresponds to Greek page i in document order. Sound only where the anchor counts agree.

lemmata.note: Both digitisations mark numbered Hippocratic lemmata. Where numbering_agrees is true the two carry identical lemma-number sets; number-to-number identity of the underlying text is a separate claim, to be tested by collation rather than asserted from markup.
